waybackify site enumerate [flags] <config.json>

Enumerate every archived version of whole sites into a ledger

Walk the CDX index for every query in a site config, inside its date
window, and write one capture list per site under --ledger:
<ledger>/<site>/captures.jsonl, one row per distinct version of
every URL, ranked so one capture of everything is fetched first.
Beside it: the raw CDX pages (cdx/), the resolved redirects, an
inventory of every CDX row with its disposition, and a summary.

HTML is listed through the normal replay (cache fill fetches its
requisites) unless a config rule marks its host raw; everything
else is listed raw (id_). Deterministic: a rerun over unchanged CDX
data rewrites nothing, and --offline rebuilds from the saved pages.

Output: progress on stderr; one JSON summary line on stdout. Exit 1
when the index stays offline — rerun the same command.

Arguments:
  <config.json>          site config: window, sites → CDX queries, per-host rules

Flags:
  --ledger <dir>         directory to write <site>/captures.jsonl (+ provenance) under — required
  --site <name>          only this site (repeatable; default: every site in the config)
  --offline              no network: rebuild from the saved CDX pages
  --no-redirects         skip 3xx Location resolution and redirect-target queries
  --repick-from <root>   skip captures this cache root holds as interstitial, error, or gone; pick the next capture of the same content
  --help|-h              Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
